highlights: Mibro Earbuds 3 Pro TWS Black - Bluetooth Headphones
Enjoy your favourite music wirelessly with the Mibro Earbuds 3 Pro TWS headphones.

These headphones offer you a high-quality Bluetooth 5.2 connection and a battery life of up to 6 hours on a single charge. Their ergonomic, lightweight design fits snugly in your ears for comfortable all-day wear.
Battery life: Approx. 104 hours (with charging case).
Seamless headset and charging bank integration.
